description:
Exhaustion risk: how much time is left in the signal's bar (session minutes,
    wall-clock minutes, sessions left, fraction left), and until when the fire stays active.

    Docs example: a 60-minute hammer that triggers at 9:32 has 58 minutes; at 10:25 it has 5.
    Once the bar closes, the signal is gone. The tool reports time; it does not grade it.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601. Decides if the last bar is still open. Default: the server clock.
now.title: Now

name: exhaustion
